evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Validate PR branch checkout in reusable workflow_call context.
intent.acceptance: Independent checkout-state evidence matches the intended caller PR head and initialized Git state.

evidence.opportunity: Every orchestrator run (github/gh-aw smoke-call-workflow) whose call-workflow safe output independently dispatched the nested smoke-workflow-call job; runs with no observed dispatch are excluded as out-of-workflow_call-context, not scored as a failed checkout.
filters: Not proof: a PASS/FAIL comment footer written by the agent itself
Not proof: the call_workflow safe-output count alone (dispatch without confirmed destination/input match)
Not proof: the worker's own schedule/workflow_dispatch run history (never reflects workflow_call context)
Not proof: editable issue/PR body or comment text
Actions run/job/log-level evidence (run lists, job steps, and logs for both workflows) could not be acquired in this measurement environment; see acquisition below.
Repository, commit, blob, and adoption facts above were independently verified via unauthenticated public git smart-HTTP clone plus SHA1 blob hashing, which remained reachable.
Complete attribution and cost accounting remain not-measured.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of digest-checked orchestrator run inventory, bound nested-dispatch receipt, and protected pre-agent Git state captured inside the nested workflow_call job; absent receipts remain null.

model.architecture: Independent source-bound run/dispatch/checkout-state conjunction; worker and orchestrator read distinct bound fields of the same nested-job run, so each module measures a different native question from shared acquisition.
model.recommendation: Do not rate value until authentic invocation/checkout receipts exist; preserve partial evidence independently rather than treating run success as proof.

metrics.name: Verified workflow_call checkouts
metrics.formula: Count independently verified nested-job checkouts whose head/ref match the orchestrator-forwarded expectation and whose Git state is clean, initialized, origin-bound, with visible history.

metrics.name: Verified intended workflow_call heads
metrics.formula: Count independent intended head/ref matches inside the nested job; does not assert a clean workspace.
